checks.name: Native booking selection
checks.detail: Booking selection uses a compact real dropdown, preserves change handling and fits the mobile viewport.

checks.name: Staged fictional workflow fixtures and duplicate replay
checks.detail: Test-only fixture import prepared eight original engine sources once; replay preserved ten cases. Current Add message and reviewed assignment are tested separately in the inbox profile.

checks.name: Intake, unknown outcome and accounting
checks.detail: Missing DOB prevented approval; lost response preserved the proposal; reconciliation and a separate Xero check were required before closure.

checks.name: Employee onboarding
checks.detail: Staff profile read-back and separate payroll reference were required; screening approval was not granted.

checks.name: Returned agreement filing
checks.detail: Signed status followed checked native filing and read-back, without an upload API.

checks.name: Cancellation and recipient delivery
checks.detail: Single occurrence remained unchanged until verification. Failed delivery stayed separate from the write and delivered once after retry.

checks.name: Cross-workspace replacement cover
checks.detail: Office posted and verified a native offer; selected Worker accepted; assignment changed only after office review and read-back.

checks.name: Non-expiring document correction
checks.detail: Explicit evidence and date clearing followed the native review/read-back path.

checks.name: Native care and financial checks
checks.detail: Worker care evidence reached office review. Financial checks identified source discrepancies without financial release.

checks.name: Consent, privacy and stale arrival
checks.detail: Only Worker started a consented estimate. Client had no playback control/route request or other participant bookings; stale ETA was withdrawn in Arrival, reachable from Home, and sharing could stop. Mapbox network fallback was used.

checks.name: Reload persistence and responsive layout
checks.detail: Browser case state and audit persisted after reload; captured desktop/mobile viewports had no horizontal overflow.

checks.name: Workspace navigation
checks.detail: Twenty-two office, worker and participant sections rendered headings without mobile page overflow; persona selectors remain explicitly a demo rather than separate user permissions.

checks.name: Public intake to office handoff
checks.detail: An unauthenticated requester was gated by postcode, submitted consented fictional details to the isolated server, and appeared in the office queue after a fresh sign-in preserving its route. Capacity and the final ShiftCare handoff remain office decisions.

checks.name: Runtime and integration boundary
checks.detail: No uncaught browser exception; no live ShiftCare mutation or external financial/message operation.

mapbox: External calls blocked deliberately; fallback, privacy and ETA state verified.
productionLimit: No real mailbox/OCR, ShiftCare writes, background jobs, payroll release, secure worker/client identities or device GPS certified.
